name: lean-quota-monitor
description: Minimal VS Code status bar monitor for AI quotas, credits, and loose custom status commands.

leanQuotaMonitor.providerOrder.description: Display order for built-in and custom providers. Edit this setting in settings.json; Hover arrow controls update it automatically.

leanQuotaMonitor.openaiName.description: Display name shown in hover details for OpenAI Codex quota.

leanQuotaMonitor.openaiLabel.description: Status bar name for OpenAI Codex quota.

leanQuotaMonitor.openaiVisible.description: Show OpenAI Codex quota in the Status Bar. Hover details remain visible.

leanQuotaMonitor.anthropicName.description: Display name shown in hover details for Anthropic Claude quota.

leanQuotaMonitor.anthropicLabel.description: Status bar name for Anthropic Claude quota.

leanQuotaMonitor.anthropicVisible.description: Show Anthropic Claude quota in the Status Bar. Hover details remain visible.

leanQuotaMonitor.geminiName.description: Display name shown in hover details for Google Gemini quota.

leanQuotaMonitor.geminiLabel.description: Status bar name for Gemini quota.

leanQuotaMonitor.geminiVisible.description: Show Gemini quota in the Status Bar. Hover details remain visible.

leanQuotaMonitor.minimaxName.description: Display name shown in hover details for MiniMax quota.

leanQuotaMonitor.minimaxLabel.description: Status bar name for MiniMax quota.

leanQuotaMonitor.minimaxVisible.description: Show MiniMax quota in the Status Bar. Hover details remain visible.

leanQuotaMonitor.kimiName.description: Display name shown in hover details for Kimi Code quota.

leanQuotaMonitor.kimiLabel.description: Status bar name for Kimi Code quota.

leanQuotaMonitor.kimiVisible.description: Show Kimi Code quota in the Status Bar. Hover details remain visible.

leanQuotaMonitor.zaiName.description: Display name shown in hover details for Z.AI GLM Coding Plan quota.

leanQuotaMonitor.zaiLabel.description: Status bar name for Z.AI GLM Coding Plan quota.

leanQuotaMonitor.zaiVisible.description: Show Z.AI GLM Coding Plan quota in the Status Bar. Hover details remain visible.

leanQuotaMonitor.openrouterName.description: Display name shown in hover details for OpenRouter credits.

leanQuotaMonitor.openrouterLabel.description: Status bar name for OpenRouter remaining credits.

leanQuotaMonitor.openrouterVisible.description: Show OpenRouter remaining credits in the Status Bar. Hover details remain visible.

leanQuotaMonitor.customProviders.description: Custom Providers. Key = Provider Name; label = Status Bar Name; script stdout = Status Output. Scripts must exit 0 and print exactly one non-empty Status Output without the Status Bar Name; rendered Status Bar text is capped at 10 characters.

label.description: Status Bar Name. The script stdout is the Status Output and must not repeat this name.

script.description: Executable script path; no shell command or arguments.

visible.description: Show this custom provider in the Status Bar. Hover and Quick Pick remain visible.

scripts.lint: biome check src tests package.json biome.json
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write src tests package.json biome.json
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm test && pnpm run compile && pnpm run typecheck:tests
